description: Installation of two static internally illuminated signs to replace the two existing static signs, refurbishment of existing clock face with LED illumination to replace existing neon clock face illumination and installation of two 9 x 6m static LED screens to replace the two existing static advertising boards.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The advertisment display hereby approved shall be for a period of 5 years
Condition : 2 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant permission

Condition : 3 - No advertisement shall be sited or displayed so as to-
(a) endanger persons using any public highway, railway, waterway, dock, harbour or aerodrome (civil or military);
(b) obscure, or hinder the ready interpretation of, any traffic sign, railway signal or aid to navigation by water or air; or
(c) hinder the operation of any device used for the purpose of security or surveillance or for measuring the speed of any vehicle.
Condition : 4 - Any advertisement displayed, and any site used for the display of advertisments, shall be maintained in a condition that does not impair the visual amenity of the site
Condition : 5 - Any structure or hoarding erected and used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a condition that does not endanger the public

Condition : 6 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Procedure Document (A46523) [received 13/10/2020], Drawings 19142- MCM-XX-ZZ-DR-A- 01130 (P02),19142- MCM-XX-ZZ-DR-A- 01129 (P03), 19142- MCM-XX-ZZ-DR-A- 01128(P03), 19142- MCM-XX-ZZ-DR-A- 01127(P03), 19142- MCM-XX-ZZ-DR-A- 01126(03), 19142- MCM-XX-ZZ-DR-A- 01125(P03), 19142- MCM-XX-ZZ-DR-A- 01121(P03) and 19142- MCM-XX-ZZ-DR-A- 01120(P03) [received 06/10/2020], and Drawings 19142-MCM-XX-ZZ-DR-A- 01122(01), 19142- MCM-XX-ZZ-DR-A- 01124(02), 19142-MCM-XX-ZZ-DR-A- 01123(01) and 19142 MCM-XX-ZZ-DR-A- 01102(01) [received 12/08/2020]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 7 - The internal illumination levels of the clockface hereby approved shall not exceed 150 cd/m2 and the intensity of illumination for the other advertisements shall not exceed 300 cd/m2 at any time.

Condition : 8 - Signs shall be fitted with a light intensity monitoring censor to ensure the illuminance intensity is dimmable to take account of ambient light conditions and comply with the maximum recommended lighting intensity.

Condition : 9 - The luminance levels will be checked once every 6 months and adjusted if necessary to ensure that the lighting intensity during daylight and darkness remains within the permitted levels as prescribed in conditions (7) and (8) above.

Condition : 10 - The double sided advert panel hereby approved shall be static display and shall not display any moving, or apparently moving, images, animations, intermittent light sources or cold cathode tubing. The lighting is to be as described in the specification and the LED advert shall not change at a frequency greater than 24 hours, with any change in advertisement display being instantaneous.

Condition : 11 - All vehicles associated with the installation shall only park/ stop at permitted locations and within the time periods permitted by existing on-street restrictions. No skips or construction materials shall be kept on the footway or carriageway on the TLRN at any time during installation or maintenance of the structures. Temporary obstruction during the installation must be kept to a minimum and should not encroach on the clear space needed to provide safe passage for pedestrians, or obstruct the flow of traffic.
Condition : 12 - The advertisement proposals hereby approved shall be erected in full compliance with the submitted Construction Logistics Plan/Risk Assessment (Procedure Document (A46523)).
